comum.fusoDaPasta: times in each folder's time zone

entrada.tentativasDemais: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
entrada.esqueceu: Forgot your password? An administrator of your organisation resets it for you.

primeiroAcesso.explicacao: Your account was created with a temporary password. Set a new one to continue.
primeiroAcesso.regra: At least 8 characters, with one capital letter, one number and one special character. Stored with argon2id.

inicio.operando: You are working on {organizacao}. Choose where to start.
inicio.escolhaOrganizacao: Choose an organisation in the selector above to work on folders, texts and users. Until you do, you only see the system screens.
inicio.blocoPainelSub: What went out and what comes next
inicio.blocoPainelTexto: Next publication for each folder, next text in the queue, latest published, and the alerts for errors or short queues.
inicio.blocoTextosSub: Write, import, export and check the history
inicio.blocoTextosTexto: Each folder's queue, with optional image and reordering. CSV and XLSX import, export in five formats, and the publication history.
inicio.blocoConfiguracaoSub: Folders, users and the organisation's audit log
inicio.blocoConfiguracaoTexto: Telegram destination groups, time zone and schedule for each folder, who has access to what, and the record of everything that changed.
inicio.blocoSistemaTexto: Creating and maintaining organisations, the destination for operational alerts, and the state of the bot and the dispatcher.

painel.semOrganizacao: No active organisation chosen. Pick one in the selector at the top to see its dashboard.
painel.comErro: {quantidade} publication(s) with errors — those folders' queues do not move until it is fixed
painel.filaCurtaExplicacao: Below five pending texts the system warns you.
painel.filaVaziaReinicia: empty queue — when it runs out, the queue restarts
painel.filaVaziaPara: empty queue — when it runs out, the system stops and warns
painel.nadaPublicado: Nothing published yet. The first publication shows up here as soon as the dispatcher runs a slot.
painel.nenhumaPasta: No folder is visible to you yet.

textos.pularTitulo: Sends it to the end of the queue
textos.arrasteOuSetas: Drag the rows or use the arrows.
textos.limpeOsFiltros: Clear the filters to reorder the queue.
textos.poucosPendentes: This folder has only {quantidade} pending text(s).
textos.aoEsgotarConfigurado: When it runs out, the configured behaviour is {comportamento}.
textos.semPasta: No folder is visible to you yet. An administrator needs to create the folder and, if your profile is “user”, assign it to you.

editor.acimaDoLimiteTexto: With an image attached the limit is 1024 characters, because the text goes as the photo caption. Shorten the text or remove the image to go back to the 4096 limit.
editor.regraDaImagem: JPEG, PNG or WebP. The image is resized to at most 1600 px on the longer side, recompressed, and its EXIF metadata is stripped.
editor.imagemGuardada: Image stored in the database and served through an authenticated route.
editor.marcadaParaRemocao: Image marked for removal — the limit goes back to 4096 characters.
editor.comoVaiSair: With an image, sending uses sendPhoto with the text as the caption. Without one, sendMessage.
editor.entraNoFim: goes to the end of {pasta}'s queue
editor.arquivadoDesde: This text has been archived since {quando}. It does not enter the queue.
editor.explicacaoPublicar: Publish now sends to the group right away and records the publication as manual. Skip moves the text to the end of the queue without publishing.
editor.semChatId: Set the folder chat_id before publishing.
editor.explicacaoTirar: Archiving keeps the record and is the normal path. Deleting removes the text — the publication history survives, because each publication keeps what went out.

historico.textoExcluido: text deleted after publication — content kept here
historico.vazio: No publications yet. They show up here as soon as the dispatcher runs the first slot.
historico.explicacao: Each row is a slot (folder, scheduled date, scheduled time) — the same unique key that guarantees idempotency: a slot never appears twice. Imported history has no scheduled time and is never re-sent by the dispatcher.

alertas.semDestino: No destination configured: alerts stay in the log and in this panel, which is the third level of the precedence in section 7.4 — and that is a valid state, not a failure.
alertas.aFilaNaoAvanca: the queue does not move until it is fixed
alertas.falhaDeCanal: A failing alert channel never interrupts publishing and never raises another alert — it only goes to the log.

importacao.somenteTexto: Import is text only — images come in when editing each text.
importacao.colunaDataExplicacao: When filled in, the row comes in as published on that date — that is how you bring history over from another app. The dispatcher never re-sends those rows.
importacao.nenhumaColunaData: — none: everything comes in as pending —
importacao.semColunaDeOrdem: There is no order column to map: the queue order is the order of the rows in the file.
importacao.mostrandoPrimeiras: Showing the first {mostradas} rows of {total}. The import processes the whole file.
importacao.duplicatasNaoGravadas: Duplicates and discarded rows are not saved. Everything goes in a single transaction.
importacao.nenhuma: No imports in this folder yet.

exportacao.seraoExportados: {quantidade} text(s) will be exported with these filters.
exportacao.respeitaEscopo: The export respects what you can see: a user with two assigned folders exports only those two. Dates come out in the folder's time zone, stated in the file header.
